items.title: Mike Tomlin reveals the Minecraft city he built for 12 years
items.summary: Former Steelers coach Mike Tomlin posted "Tonight. 8 p.m. My Minecraft City." (163K likes) and premiered a YouTube tour of a Minecraft city he has been building for 12 years, down to the interiors of its high-rise apartments. Clips of the tour took over the timeline and the jokes followed: "mike tomlin has 100% stood on an nfl sideline pretending to listen to the headset while thinking about something he was gonna build in minecraft later" (62K), a fake report that he banned Antonio Brown from his server for blowing up a hospital with TNT (43K), and people asking what happened to the villagers who used to live there.
